subject: Logic
title: What Is Expected Value?
description: A fast breakdown of What Is Expected Value? for builders.

hook.text: A coin flip: heads you win $200, tails you lose $100. Should you play? Your gut says risky. Math says absolutely.

buildup.text: Expected value multiplies each outcome by its probability and sums the results.

discovery.text: Here: (0.5 × $200) + (0.5 × −$100) = $50. On average, you gain $50 per flip. It's a great bet.

twist.text: But expected value assumes you can play many times. A single bet that could ruin you is a different calculation.

climax.text: Expected value is the foundation of rational betting. It strips emotion and reveals the math underneath.

quiz.question: How is expected value calculated?
options: Multiply each outcome by its probability and sum
